business_summary: InvesTech Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the network system integration, network infrastructure solutions, network professional services, smart office software solutions, and network equipment rental business. The company's network system integration services comprise enterprise Internet architecture, IP bearer network architecture, data center and storage program, optical transmission network, wireless coverage program, application delivery program, security interconnection and access monitoring program, and network management program. Its professional network services include network system services, such as preparation, planning, design, implementation, operation, maintenance, and optimization; network planning, design, and project management services; and network system maintenance services comprising network operation and maintenance, management and security, hosting, evaluation, and consultation, as well as performance test, design, integration, and other services. The company also offers smart office suite software solutions, including reception, signage, WiFi, meeting, workspace, energy, and collaborations; cloud management services; and administrative support and technology development services, as well as rents network equipment. In addition, it provides installation, maintenance, and construction contracts for communication network infrastructure, and smart city and smart IT related projects. It serves customers in the Mainland China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company was formerly known as HL Technology Group Limited and changed its name to InvesTech Holdings Limited in June 2016. InvesTech Holdings Limited was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
